SUPPLY AGREEMENT

This Supply Agreement is made between Brightwave Components Ltd, a company of the People's Republic of China (the "Supplier"), and Nordlicht Trade d.o.o., Belgrade (the "Buyer"). All parties and goods in this document are invented for testing.

1. Delivery
1.1 The Supplier shall deliver the goods FOB Shanghai. The goods are shipped in 40-foot containers by sea and by rail to the port.
1.2 The estimated delivery date is approximately eight weeks after the order.

2. Price and Payment
2.1 The Buyer shall pay 100% of the price in advance by wire transfer.
2.2 Any further invoices are payable within 15 days after the invoice date.
2.3 If the Buyer pays late, it shall pay a penalty of 1% per day of the overdue amount.

3. Warranty
3.1 The Supplier warrants the goods for 6 months from delivery.
3.2 The Buyer must notify any defect within 7 days of delivery. Goods are deemed accepted if the Buyer does not object within 5 days.

4. Liability
4.1 In no event shall the Supplier be liable for indirect or consequential damages or loss of profit.
4.2 The Supplier's aggregate liability shall not exceed 20% of the price of the goods.
4.3 The Supplier excludes liability for gross negligence.

5. Term
5.1 This Agreement is valid for 12 months and renews automatically for successive periods of 12 months.

6. Changes and Termination
6.1 The Supplier may change prices and terms at any time without prior notice.
6.2 The Supplier may terminate this Agreement at any time without cause.
6.3 The Supplier may assign or subcontract its rights without the Buyer's consent.

7. Resale
7.1 The Buyer may resell the goods in Serbia, Kazakhstan and Russia.

8. Data
8.1 The parties may exchange personal data of their employees. Data may be transferred to third countries.

9. Governing Law
9.1 This Agreement is governed by the laws of the People's Republic of China. The United Nations Convention on Contracts for the International Sale of Goods shall not apply.

10. Disputes
10.1 Any dispute shall be submitted to arbitration with its seat in Shenzhen under the rules of the Shenzhen Court of International Arbitration.
